title: Apache Commons Text longest common subsequence on two distinct score rows
summary: Compare the public score in Commons Text 1.13.1 with exhaustive subsequence enumeration. An altered build makes the two working rows share storage.

change.description: The row-sharing change is a constructed negative control.

verdictLabel: JVM oracle agrees on 225 release inputs and disagrees on 44 control inputs
notes: Each CharSequence operand is an actual String of length zero to three over a and b. The original and altered source builds use the same compiler and flags. The release JAR is a third, independently checked artifact.

The release and source rebuild each matched 225 expected scores. The shared-row control differed on 44. The public native probe at unwind 18 and array bound 4 reached the multidimensional allocation and reported it outside the fragment. See the probe intention in history and the matching execution in records.
